intro.fr: An Untitled Story a eu un randomizer autonome de Mokesmoe, à partir duquel a été construite son intégration multiworld.
intro.en: An Untitled Story had a standalone randomizer by Mokesmoe, on which its multiworld integration was built.

text.fr: Maddy Thorson sort An Untitled Story en 2007.
text.en: Maddy Thorson releases An Untitled Story in 2007.

text.fr: Mokesmoe a créé un randomizer autonome pour le jeu, et a permis de s'en servir pour son intégration au multiworld, à laquelle Black Silver a aussi contribué.
text.en: Mokesmoe created a standalone randomizer for the game, and allowed it to be used for its multiworld integration, to which Black Silver also contributed.
